rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or body part physically trembling or quivering.

example.english: It’s so cold that my hands tremble.
example.jyutping: dung3 dou3 ngo5 zek3 sau2 dou1 faat3 dau2

rows.note: Use this mainly when an object or surface is shaking or vibrating, rather than a person visibly quivering.

example.english: The shaking table makes me tremble, so don't move it.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 zan3 gan2 m4 hou2 juk1 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when “tremble” means to fear or be afraid, rather than to shake physically.

example.english: I tremble with fear as soon as I see the snake.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 tiu4 se4 zau6 ging1
